  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

flux alloc \
  -N 3 \
  -n 96 \
  --time=30m \

# reducing throughput/resiliency.

# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

# reproduce "--mpi=pmi2" here.

# provides an MPI launcher compatible with Flux.

module purge
module load gcc cuda mvapich2/2.2

NAMD="/projects/jdb252_1/tj227/bin/namd2-2.13-gcc-mvapich2"

$NAMD starting.POCG_60.namd > starting.POCG_60.log
